theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the only remaining eligible theme with a coherent trending structure — durability_bar 0.80 (highest in the table), hurst_tag 'trend', and breadth 0.90 (near-unanimous participation). It sits just behind Banks on headline score (1.153 vs 1.337) but with much better breadth and trend-health, making it the cleaner single-theme staying-power candidate. This is not a claim that momentum predicts return; it is a claim that the combination of trend-health, breadth, and gate-eligibility makes it the most defensible place to hold risk within the eligible set over the next month.
evidence: breadth 0.90 — broadest participation of any eligible theme
gate_helps true — absolute-trend gate validated for drawdown avoidance
